First off I wanna say I'm a pretty experienced psychedelic user, I'm only 16 and started doing drugs when I was 13,
I've done over 30 different drugs and can handle a lot.
A buddy and I got our hands on some 2 - CB. Before we got it I was planning on shooting it, because I wanted it to hit me like a blast of DMT and not have to use as much. We both got a 20mg capsule (which we found out later it was more around 30mg) so we went back to our place to consume it. I was having second thoughts about it because I did Datura the previous night but since it was a full moon we decided to anyways. We didn't have any clean rigs and my buddy was too lazy to walk with me to the needle exchange so we took 2 dirty rigs out of the garbage and I bleached them. I prepped our shots and then right before we were about to do it another one of our buddy's walked in with a capsule of MDA. Him and my buddy that I was doing the 2 - CB with were going to sniff half each but then he decided he didn't want it, so he let me have it, I got the idea to shoot the MDA one after another but my buddy says no man, just make it one Big super shot, and oh man that only describes part of it.
I shoot my buddy up with his rig, then I do me and within a few seconds a massive intense rush of visuals engulf me. There was trillions of colours and geometric patterns similar to DMT. Very cirucal geometric shapes. I found there was certain aspects of LSD that were similar but not the same, same with DMT but certainly almost if just intense. There was patterns EVERYWHERE, the air looked like jelly kinda. So many dimensions to everything, VERY INTENSE! I just wish I could explain them better. Also for the first minute I was getting hot spots on my body that moved rapidly around from place to place. Some times certain colours would infect certain parts of the visuals, instead of a bunch just being mixed in together.
My buddy stated its like his schizophrenia when its at its peak, just with a ton more colours. He also said he should of researched it first because he had no idea what he was in for. We chain smoked cigarettes for the first half hour, a few with mug wort and when we exhaled the smoke looked like Celtic knots. For the first 10 - 15 minutes I thought I was going to die since I didn't know the lethal dose for 2-CB and mixed it with MDA. So I had some pretty bad anxiety for that amount of time until I accepted I was going to die, then everything went nice and smooth from there. I also had non stop demonic laughter for 3 hours of the trip. A few things from the wall across the room seemed to stretch out a few inches from my face. I had a good time.
Also had a very hard time speaking proper sentences and finding words.
